analytics_privacy: CONFIRMED no visitor PII in analytics events or analytics URLs, by code reading (not by live traffic capture). Client bus js/modules/analytics.js: PII_PARAM_PATTERN drops any key matching address|arquivo|cnpj|cpf|email|empresa|nome|name|message|mensagem|phone|tel|whatsapp|text|query|search|… (:14), values >180 chars dropped, looksLikePiiValue drops '@', 8+ digit runs, 10-15 digit phones, 14-digit CNPJ, while allowing envelope ids sess-/lead-/opp-/prop-/sale-/c- (:212-240,264-290); AGGREGATE_PII_ALLOWLIST empty (:13) and any non-empty allowlist aborts tracking (:277); unknown/custom_/retired events rejected (:207-218); lead_form_error validation_category restricted to required|contact_format|rate_limited (:278). Payload to /api/web/collect carries only event, props (sanitized), path = pathname (no query), sid (:187-197); page_path everywhere is window.location.pathname. Form events (form.js:159-167,317-329,464-494,500-524): stage_category/urgency_category/cta_label = finite <select> values, journey, asset_id, cta_id, route_family, receipt_id/lead_id = protocol lead-…; no nome/email/telefone/mensagem keys are ever passed (and would be dropped by pattern). nav.js CTA events send cta_label = link textContent sliced 80 (nav.js:1159) — static CTA copy; WhatsApp CTAs include the company's own number '(48) 98834-4559' (business data, not visitor PII; passes filter because digits are hyphen-separated). internal_search sends query_len only (nav.js:303-308). Attribution from URL: only allowlisted keys tema/origem/jornada/utm_*/pseo keys, each through sanitizeAttr (drops '@', phone-like, >180) before hidden fields/sessionStorage (nav.js:319-333,398-407,443-470,579-582); these go to the lead POST, not to analytics (landing_url/referrer keys are hidden inputs). WhatsApp fallback link text uses only estagio/journey (form.js:563-566) and appendWhatsappProtocol adds a c- protocol (README F005 refuted). Server: netlify/functions/lib/event-contract.cjs re-applies pii_keys denylist + looksLikePiiValue + strict_no_pii_props (:127-233,278-311) against netlify/functions/lib/event-registry.json (pii_policy aggregate_allowlist_empty :4-5, pii_keys :1106, lead_form_error strict_no_pii_props :603). URLs: success redirect /obrigado?receipt=lead-<27hex> carries a protocol id only (form.js:532-537). Residual: /nurture/ form has no action/method so a no-JS submit would GET /nurture/?email=… (first-party URL/server log only; not an analytics event) — see findings. Delivery e-mail (Resend) and Warmbly payload intentionally carry contact PII over TLS (lead-delivery.cjs:420-437) — operational channels, not analytics; safeLog redacts (lead-core.cjs:1432). findings.finding: Capture form on /ferramentas/checklist-reequilibrio/ is not bound by the shared lead runtime: name="checklist-reequilibrio" does not match the only binding selector form[name="diagnostico-b2g"], form[name="diagnostico-confenge"] (nav.js:584), and the whole submit/fetch/idempotency/receipt block of form.js lives inside that if (form) scope (nav.js:1359 → form.js:4-680). No other script binds it (tools-common.js, tool-compute.js, tool-persist.js, inline script bind only #f; grep reequilibrio-capture-form in script.js and assets/js = 0). Result: submit is a native urlencoded POST to /.netlify/functions/lead; the Turnstile widget still renders (slot injected at build by _CAPTURE_FORM_RE, scheduleTurnstile is slot-based), so the server can persist and answer 201 JSON which the browser renders raw — no /obrigado-contrato, no visible protocol despite data-receipt-required="true" and data-success-destination, no client idempotency key (server falls back to 15-min content bucket), no lead_form_submit/lead_form_success/lead_persisted/cta_click analytics, no honeypot/timeout UX. Violates the AGENTS.md rule that active forms claim a receipt only with real persistence and a functional flow.
findings.evidence: ferramentas/checklist-reequilibrio/index.html:91 (name="checklist-reequilibrio" id="reequilibrio-capture-form" data-ajax="true" data-receipt-required="true" data-success-destination="/obrigado-contrato"); js/modules/nav.js:584,1359; js/modules/form.js:422-680; script.js contains the same selector; scripts/site/test_tools_structure.mjs:181 checks only structure, not name/binding; introduced in 45d683a62 (#61 debt closure). Live behaviour not exercised (read-only audit) — runtime consequence is inferred from code, mark end-to-end effect UNVERIFIED.
findings.minimal_fix: Rename the form to name="diagnostico-confenge" (one attribute in ferramentas/checklist-reequilibrio/index.html:91) or widen nav.js:584 to also match form[data-runtime-profile="shared_lead_form_v1"]; add an assertion in scripts/site/test_tools_structure.mjs (or cta_form_next_state_audit) that every form with data-runtime-profile=shared_lead_form_v1 has a name the runtime binds. Then rebuild script.js only if nav.js changed (build_script_modules --write) and follow the CSS-free recapture chain.

findings.finding: /servicos-obras-publicas/ capture form has no telefone field and makes e-mail required, contradicting the 'one channel (WhatsApp or e-mail)' contract every other capture form and the server enforce (lead-core.cjs:977-983 accepts either). Visitors who only want WhatsApp return cannot submit; copy states 'e-mail profissional' as mandatory.
findings.evidence: servicos-obras-publicas/index.html:145-146 (data-field-purpose 'Obrigatórios: evento observado, nome do representante, e-mail profissional e o consentimento'); email input has required, grep -c telefone = 0; compare medicoes-glosas-obras-publicas/index.html:234 hint 'um canal de retorno (WhatsApp ou e-mail)'.
findings.minimal_fix: Add the standard telefone input (pattern/inputmode as in the pillar template) and drop required from email; update the data-field-purpose hint; run test:cta-form-next-state / inbound gates.

findings.finding: No capture form has a working no-JS submission path in production, and only the home tells the visitor so. LEAD_REQUIRE_TURNSTILE=1 (prontidao §5) makes verifyTurnstile return turnstile_missing → 403 anti_abuse for any POST without token (lead-delivery.cjs:194-202, lead.cjs:377-392), and the token only exists after form.js initTurnstile runs (form.js:797-825). Without JS, pillar/casos/entregas/ferramentas forms POST natively to /.netlify/functions/lead and receive raw JSON {error:'anti_abuse'}. Only index.html carries .form-nojs-note (html.no-js gated, index.html:2,16; assets/home-10x.css:317-318). Contextual fallback without JS depends on adjacent static links: present (wa.me) on pillars and 7/8 casos/modelo, mailto on /entregas/; absent near the form (footer mailto only) on /ferramentas/checklist-reequilibrio/, /ferramentas/diagnostico-defesa-margem/, /ferramentas/limite-acrescimos-supressoes/, /casos/modelo-relatorio-inteligencia-licitacoes/, /analise-cnpj/ (no wa.me/mailto in body).
findings.evidence: per-form census above (nojs-note=0 on all routes except index.html; wa/mailto counts); build_site.py:642-690 injects the slot in every capture form but the widget script is JS-loaded; lead.cjs:123-141 parseBody accepts urlencoded so the server is reached and refuses on Turnstile.
findings.minimal_fix: Add the home's .form-nojs-note pattern (and the html.no-js/js class swap) to the shared pillar/casos/ferramentas form templates, pointing to the adjacent WhatsApp/e-mail links; where no adjacent channel exists, add the contact-alt list (wa.me + mailto) next to the form. No server change needed.

findings.finding: /nurture/ form has neither action nor method; if the inline handler fails to run (JS disabled/blocked), the browser submits GET /nurture/?track=…&email=…&consent=on, placing the subscriber e-mail in a first-party URL (server access logs, browser history, Referer to any third party linked from the result). Analytics is unaffected (pathname only), but it is the one place where PII can reach a URL.
findings.evidence: nurture/index.html:123 (<form id="nurture-form" data-capture-form novalidate>, no action/method); handler nurture/index.html:152-166 (preventDefault + fetch POST /.netlify/functions/nurture?action=subscribe); js/modules/analytics.js:57 lists /nurture/ as chrome prefix.
findings.minimal_fix: Set method="post" action="/.netlify/functions/nurture?action=subscribe" on the form (server behaviour for urlencoded POST UNVERIFIED — confirm nurture.cjs accepts it or returns a safe 4xx) so a no-JS submit never encodes the e-mail in the query string; optionally add a noscript note.

findings.finding: Operator read of the Resend correlation handle requires PII exposure: ops action=lead without pii=1 returns delivery only as {notify:<status>, email:<status>}; provider_id/http/reason are only in the pii=1 projection together with nome/telefone/email. The g03 protocol works around it with jq on the host.
findings.minimal_fix: Include delivery.email.provider_id/http/reason/idempotency_key in the redacted (pii=0) lead projection in lib/lead-stages.cjs publicLeadSummary — they are provider ids, not PII — and add an assertion in scripts/revops/test_lead_stages.mjs.
